In the following exercises, use an exponential model to solve.
questions.text: Edgar accumulated \(\$5,000\) in credit card debt. If the interest rate is \(20%\) per year, and he does not make any payments for 2 years, how much will he owe on this debt in 2 years by each method of compounding? ⓐ compound quarterly ⓑ compound monthly ⓒ compound continuously

context: Use exponential models in applications

questions.text: Nazerhy deposits \(\$8,000\) in a certificate of deposit. The annual interest rate is \(6%\) and the interest will be compounded quarterly. How much will the certificate be worth in 10 years?

context: Use exponential models in applications

questions.text: A researcher at the Center for Disease Control and Prevention is studying the growth of a bacteria. He starts his experiment with 100 of the bacteria that grows at a rate of \(6%\) per hour. He will check on the bacteria every 8 hours. How many bacteria will he find in 8 hours?

context: Use exponential models in applications
